30309.context: If God brought us together, then God has to fix it. If you're just the one, if you're just the soulmate, then there is nothing to fix. We just got to deal with what we got, you know. So Bridge City is taking a different approach to that. Doing doing relationships beyond superstition means acknowledging that agency is the engine. It's not a mystery why a relationship works or fails.
